status: D2 OPEN; no h plateau; independent Elmer and full repository tests still pending
provenance: Actual local SciPy solve with extracted repository Nedelec A-phi weak form and physical BFZI closed source. Tree gauge branch prototype. The actual repository implementation has been committed, but full repository has NOT been executed.

physical.coil: two separate 2-turn continuous BFZI rounded squares with explicit closed returns
physical.case: two sealed dry boxes centered z=±0.13m, half extents (.1,.1,.015)
physical.port: same Whitney chord functional for excitation and readout, subtract same-domain vacuum

tree_method: Relative boundary-rooted spanning forest fixes one internal edge DOF per interior vertex; omit gauge Lagrange multiplier, retain scalar electric potential. Entire actual material and vacuum systems factored with sparse direct solver.
limitations: The source polygon, seawater h and outer R are not independently converged.
Discrete port/Joule closure is an algebraic identity, not a continuous-field accuracy guarantee.
Tree-cotree reduction is valid here for a connected simply connected cubical mesh with prescribed tangential A. No claim for arbitrary topology.
The isolated local code is an extraction of the repository, not a whole-checkout test.
No copper skin/proximity impedance or thermal reference and no independent Gmsh/Elmer pass.
